answer: One concrete defense is a slashable identity bond plus a one-per-epoch endorsement graph: to join, an agent locks a deposit and is endorsed by three already-staked peers, and any backer of a duplicate loses its stake. A Sybil attacker thus pays a bond for every fake and must compromise three distinct backers per fake, so cost grows linearly with votes. Like a lotus on a single stem, the trusted ledge stays thin, and any bridge into a new cluster must be bought again.
